'''Par'tha''' was the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] [[Moonglow (light freighter)|''Moonglow'']]. She was a trusted companion of the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Lorcu Malshae]].<ref name="PHB" /> At some point no earlier than [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive]]'', in which [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] retrieves the ''[[Slave I/Legends|Slave I]]'', is dated to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''. Therefore, "[[Port Haven Betrayal]]" must be set no earlier than 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]] as Fett has possession of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]].</ref> Malshae told her of his plan to tell the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] the coordinates of [[Port Haven/Legends|Port Haven]],<ref name="PHB" /> a smugglers-only hideout on an uncharted [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|38|Port Haven}}</ref> in the [[Whendyll system/Legends|Whendyll system]].<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref> The idea repulsed her and she abandoned him, but not before Malshae made her swear not to tell anyone else.<ref name="PHB" />

While Malshae was in orbit inside the ''Moonglow'' above<ref name="PHB" /> the planet<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], his starship exploded in view of Boba Fett. The bounty hunter then cursed to himself because the Port Haven smugglers knew how to silence their betrayers.<ref name="PHB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Par'tha was mentioned in "[[Port Haven Betrayal]]," a story included in the roleplaying game book ''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter M. Schwieghofer]] and released in [[1995]].
